decisions.statement: Each line of the argument names a page and the folder that page moves into.
A line that is not a path and a folder parted by a space is refused.
A line with nothing on it is read over.
A call handing in no line is refused.
A line whose landing is named as a file rather than a folder is refused.
A line naming the folder its page already sits in is refused.
A page carried keeps the slug that page had.
Every file a page keeps beside that page moves with the page.
A body naming a path that moved is repointed in the same answer.
A line is carried against the world the lines before it leave.
A refusal at any line refuses the whole call and names that line's pair.
A call that refuses carries no page at all.
Each carry is left to the mechanical change moving that kind of page.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here changes the data a page states.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: many pages carried into the folders their lines name, in one call
